20600.name: Through The Rubble

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnels Of Darkness.

up.description: To the up lies The Hole.

20600.description:
A slope of broken stone fills the passage, jammed between the walls
where some old collapse brought the roof down. A gap just wide enough to
squeeze through winds between the biggest slabs, and the dust you kick
up hangs in the dark like smoke. Far above, a pale scrap of daylight
marks the way up toward The Hole. The tunnel runs on south into deeper
blackness, and a cold draught creeps up it smelling of wet stone.

20601.name: The Tunnels Of Darkness

north.description: To the north lies Through The Rubble.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnels Of Darkness.

20601.description:
The tunnel narrows to a crooked bore of dark stone, its ceiling propped
here and there by timbers gone soft with rot. Pick marks scar the walls
in long, tired rows, abandoned in the middle of a swing. Your light
shrinks to a small yellow bubble, and the dark presses close beyond it.
Somewhere ahead, stones tick and settle as though the mountain were
turning over in its sleep.

20602.name: The Tunnels Of Darkness

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnels Of Darkness.

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnels Of Darkness.

20602.description:
Here the passage forks into blind pockets and half-dug alcoves, each one
ending in a wall of raw, unworked rock. A rusted wheelbarrow lies on its
side with one wheel missing, its iron rim bent as if by a great hand.
Fine grey dust coats every surface, unmarked save for a single trail
that leads nowhere you can see. The air is thin and still and tastes of
old copper.

20603.name: The Tunnels Of Darkness

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnels Of Darkness.

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnels Of Darkness.

20603.description:
A tangle of broken props and splintered boards chokes this stretch of
tunnel, leaving only a crooked path through the wreckage. Water seeps
from a crack overhead and drips into a puddle black as ink, each drop
ringing out too loudly. Scratches mark the wall at shoulder height, as
if someone had counted the days in the dark. You find yourself listening
harder than you meant to.

20604.name: The Tunnels Of Darkness

south.description: To the south lies Tunnels End.

20604.description:
The tunnel opens a little here into a low, ragged chamber where several
diggings meet, and the rock overhead glitters faintly with flecks of
mica. Rails of rusted iron run out of the gloom and stop at an ore cart
tipped on its side, its load of rubble spilled across the floor. An old
lantern hangs from a hook in the wall, cold and empty. A smell of damp
earth and something sourer drifts through the stale air.

20605.name: The Tunnels Of Darkness

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnels Of Darkness.

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnels Of Darkness.

20605.description:
The walls are slick with a pale crust that glimmers wetly, and the floor
dips toward a shallow trench worn by years of seepage. A pair of rusted
shackles hangs from a ring bolted to the rock, though nothing about the
place says what they were meant to hold. Your footsteps die at once in
the heavy air. The dark ahead seems thicker than the dark behind.

20606.name: The Tunnels Of Darkness

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnels Of Darkness.

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnels Of Darkness.

20606.description:
A great vein of dull grey stone has been chiselled out of the wall here,
leaving a ragged hollow like an open mouth. Chisels and wedges still
stand in their cracks, furred with rust, and a crooked peg beside them
holds a miner's leather cap, stiff with age. Long gouges score the rock
around the hollow, far too deep and wide for any pick. A faint scraping
drifts up from somewhere below.

20607.name: The Tunnels Of Darkness

down.description: To the down lies On The Ladder.

20607.description:
A square opening yawns in the floor where a ladder of black timber
climbs down into the deep places below. Its rungs are worn smooth by
ages of hands and boots, and a rope tied to the topmost one hangs slack
into the dark. Cold air rises from the way down, carrying a hollow echo
and the faraway smell of old stone. The tunnel itself ends here in a
heap of dust and flaked rock.

20608.name: The Tunnels Of Darkness
20608.description:
The roof drops so low here that you must stoop, and the walls crowd
close on either side, rough with the marks of hurried digging. Long
strings of old cobweb sag from the timbers, grey and heavy with dust. A
ring of melted candle stubs sits in the middle of a crude chalk circle,
its lines smeared by something dragged across it. The silence is thick
enough to feel on your skin.

extra_descs.circle chalk stubs:
The chalk circle is drawn in a hurried, shaking hand, with signs around
the edge that you do not know. A deep, curved scrape cuts across it as
if something heavy had been hauled away.

20609.name: The Tunnels Of Darkness

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnels Of Darkness.

20609.description:
This is the deepest and oldest stretch of the workings, where the walls
are not cut stone but a glassy black rock that drinks the light. Faint
veins of dull silver thread through it, pulsing so slightly you cannot
be sure you see them. The floor is warm underfoot, and the air hums with
a note just below hearing. Whatever the miners were digging for, they
found it here, and left in a hurry.

20610.name: Tunnels End

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnels Of Darkness.

south.description: To the south lies Cavern Entrance.

20610.description:
The long tunnel finally ends in a ragged archway of mortared stone,
where lamplight spills thinly from the town beyond. Dust-furred timbers
brace the arch, and the stale air of the workings gives way to cooking
smoke and warm iron. Back up the passage to the north, the darkness
waits like a held breath. To the south the way opens into the Cavern
Entrance, and the sounds of the town grow clear.

20615.name: Cavern Entrance

north.description: To the north lies Tunnels End.

east.description: To the east lies The Back Of The Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies The Cavern Centre.

west.description: To the west lies The Shopping District.

20615.description:
You step out of the tunnel into the vast cavern that holds the town, its
roof lost in gloom far above. Lanterns on iron poles throw wavering
rings of light across a floor of beaten grit and trodden stone. Behind
you the tunnel mouth breathes cold air back up the passage to the north.
The cavern stretches south toward its centre, a lane leads east along
the rear wall, and shop fronts line the way west.

20616.name: The Back Of The Cavern

north.description: To the north lies Spaymoore's Diner.

east.description: To the east lies The Back Of The Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies The Overseer's Pedestal.

west.description: To the west lies Cavern Entrance.

20616.description:
Along the rear wall of the cavern the rock is smoothed and whitewashed
in patches, and a few narrow doorways have been cut straight into it. A
hand-lettered sign on a post points north to Spaymoore's Diner, from
which come the clatter of plates and the smell of frying onions. The
lane goes on east past more houses and back west toward the entrance,
while south the ground opens toward a raised pedestal of stone. Soot has
painted the ceiling above in long black streaks.

20617.name: The Back Of The Cavern

north.description: To the north lies The Living Room.

east.description: To the east lies The North-Eastern Corner.

south.description: To the south lies Middle Of The Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies The Back Of The Cavern.

20617.description:
The lane here runs hard along the rear of the cavern, where a stoop of
worn steps leads north to a miner's front door. Pale stalactites hang
from the roof like frozen candle wax, dripping slowly onto the grit.
East the wall bends toward a corner of the cavern, while south the lane
opens into the middle of the town, and west it returns toward the diner.
A chorus of distant hammering echoes off the stone.

20618.name: The Living Room

north.description: To the north lies The Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies The Kitchen.

south.description: To the south lies The Back Of The Cavern.

20618.description:
A miner's living room, snug and low, with a threadbare rug over the bare
stone and a hearth glowing with banked coals. Two sagging armchairs face
the fire, and a shelf above holds a row of chipped mugs and a small
carved figure of a bearded dwarf. Pick handles lean beside the door
south to the cavern lane. A doorway north leads into a hallway, and a
plank door east opens on the kitchen.

20619.name: The Kitchen

west.description: To the west lies The Living Room.

20619.description:
A small kitchen where a black iron stove squats against the wall, its
pipe running up through a hole bored in the ceiling rock. Copper pans
hang over a scrubbed table, and a sack of meal slumps in a corner beside
a cask of salted pork. The room smells of bread, smoke and damp stone.
The only door lies west, back to the living room.

20620.name: The Hallway

south.description: To the south lies The Living Room.

up.description: To the up lies Upstairs In A Miner's House.

20620.description:
A narrow hallway runs between close walls of limewashed rock, hung with
a row of iron pegs for coats and lamps. A steep wooden stair climbs up
into the dark of the upper floor, its treads dished by years of heavy
boots. The room to the south is the living room, and from there comes
the murmur of the fire. The floor is swept clean, a point of pride in a
town so full of dust.

20621.name: Upstairs In A Miner's House

down.description: To the down lies The Hallway.

20621.description:
Under a slanting ceiling of raw stone, a pair of narrow beds stand
against opposite walls, each with a thin blanket folded at its foot. A
little shuttered niche lets in a dim glow from the lanterns of the town
below. Boots stand in a row beside a battered chest, and the air smells
of tallow and sleeping men. The stair leads down to the hallway.

20622.name: The North-Eastern Corner

north.description: To the north lies The Gents' Washroom.

east.description: To the east lies The Ladies' Washroom.

south.description: To the south lies The Far Eastern Wall.

west.description: To the west lies The Back Of The Cavern.

20622.description:
In the corner of the cavern the walls close in at a sharp angle, and
lantern light pools thickly where rock meets rock. A tiled passage leads
north to the gents' washroom, another east to the ladies', and the lane
runs south along the cavern's edge. Water trickles down the stone in a
bright thread to a gutter, and the whole corner smells of lye soap.
West, the lane returns toward the back of the cavern.

20623.name: The Far Eastern Wall

north.description: To the north lies The North-Eastern Corner.

east.description: To the east lies The Newsroom.

south.description: To the south lies The South Eastern Corner.

west.description: To the west lies Middle Of The Cavern.

20623.description:
The cavern's eastern flank rises here as a sheer curtain of dark rock,
streaked with mineral stains in orange and green. Lantern hooks have
been hammered into the stone at head height, and a long bench of split
logs sits beneath them where workers rest. A door to the east leads into
the newsroom, where a press clatters, while the lane runs north toward a
corner and south toward another. West, the wide middle of the cavern
opens out.

20624.name: Middle Of The Cavern

north.description: To the north lies The Back Of The Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies The Far Eastern Wall.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Escape.

west.description: To the west lies The Overseer's Pedestal.

20624.description:
The floor is worn into shallow ruts by cartwheels here, and the roof
soars so high that lamplight never reaches it. Handcarts stand abandoned
along the edge of the lane, their shafts propped on stones. To the west
rises the overseer's pedestal, a dark stump against the glow of the
lamps. Lanes lead north to the back of the cavern, east to the far wall,
and south to the Great Escape.

20625.name: The Overseer's Pedestal

north.description: To the north lies The Back Of The Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies Middle Of The Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies The Construction Site.

west.description: To the west lies The Cavern Centre.

up.description: To the up lies Atop the Pedestal.

20625.description:
A squat pillar of fitted stone rises from the cavern floor, its flat top
reached by a spiral of worn steps cut into its side. From up there the
overseer once watched every lane and every hammer, and the iron rail
around the rim is polished by his gloves. Lanes branch north toward the
back of the cavern, east to the middle, south to a building site, and
west to the centre. A chill breeze with no source stirs around the base.

extra_descs.steps spiral rail:
The steps are cut shallow and narrow, so that anyone climbing must watch
his feet. The iron rail at the top is rubbed bright where the overseer
once leaned.

20626.name: Atop the Pedestal

down.description: To the down lies The Overseer's Pedestal.

20626.description:
The flat top of the pedestal gives a commanding view over the whole
cavern, from the tunnel mouth in the rear wall to the huge stone gates
far below. An iron rail rings the rim, and in the middle stands a heavy
chair of black oak with arms worn by clenching hands. A cold wind stirs
here that no cavern should have, and the lamps below seem very small.
The stair winds down to the ground.

20627.name: The Cavern Centre

north.description: To the north lies Cavern Entrance.

east.description: To the east lies The Overseer's Pedestal.

south.description: To the south lies By The Huge Stone Gates.

west.description: To the west lies The Middle Of The Cavern.

20627.description:
The great open heart of the cavern, where lanes meet beneath a roof so
high it is lost in shadow. The ground is stamped smooth by generations
of boots, and four tall lamp-posts of black iron burn at its points. The
entrance lies north, the pedestal east, the huge stone gates south, and
the fountain district west. A low murmur of voices and hammers fills the
air like the sea.

20628.name: The Middle Of The Cavern

north.description: To the north lies The Shopping District.

east.description: To the east lies The Cavern Centre.

south.description: To the south lies The Cavern Wall.

west.description: To the west lies The Stone Fountain.

20628.description:
A broad, gently sloping stretch of packed grit lies beneath the western
half of the vault, patched with puddles from the roof's constant drip.
Handcarts have worn twin ruts across it, leading north toward the
shopping district. The wall of the cavern lies south, the centre of the
town east, and the splash of the stone fountain carries clearly from the
west.

20629.name: The Stone Fountain

north.description: To the north lies In Front Of The Shops.

east.description: To the east lies The Middle Of The Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies The Cavern Wall.

west.description: To the west lies The Extreme Western Wall.

20629.description:
The stone fountain stands at the heart of the cavern town, a wide basin
of grey rock where water pours from the mouth of a carved, bearded face.
Spray beads on the rim and runs in rills down the grooves of the
pavement. Miners stop to rinse the dust from their hands and throats,
and the splash covers the hammering from elsewhere. Lanes lead north to
the shops, east to the middle of the cavern, south along the cavern
wall, and west to the edge of the town.

extra_descs.face fountain spout basin:
The carved face is a bearded miner with his mouth wide open, the water
pouring from it in a clear, cold stream. Generations of coins lie green
at the bottom of the basin.

20630.name: The Extreme Western Wall

north.description: To the north lies Entrance To The Treasury.

east.description: To the east lies The Stone Fountain.

south.description: To the south lies The South Western Corner.

west.description: To the west lies The Doctor's Waiting Room.

20630.description:
Along the extreme western edge of the cavern the rock face is dark and
damp, and a long channel cut in the floor carries a thin stream of water
away into the shadows. Shuttered shop-fronts and low doors line the
lane. North stands the entrance to the treasury, south the lane drops to
a corner, east the fountain plays, and west a door leads to the doctor's
waiting room.

20631.name: Entrance To The Treasury

north.description: To the north lies The Treasury Master's Office.

east.description: To the east lies In Front Of The Shops.

south.description: To the south lies The Extreme Western Wall.

west.description: To the west lies The Treasury.

20631.description:
A heavy iron door set in a frame of dressed stone is the entrance to the
town's treasury, studded with bolts and flanked by two lamps in wire
cages. The ground before it is swept clean and marked with a pale line
where visitors must wait. A side door north is lettered for the treasury
master, a second door west leads into the vault itself, and lanes run
east to the front of the shops and south along the wall.

20632.name: The Treasury

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Treasury.

20632.description:
A low vault of seamless stone, its walls lined with iron-bound chests
and shelves of ingots stamped with the town's mark. A balance of brass
pans hangs from a beam, and a chalk tally on the wall counts bars and
coin in careful columns. The air is cold and still as a tomb. The only
way out is the iron door east.

20633.name: In Front Of The Shops

north.description: To the north lies Bits and Pieces.

east.description: To the east lies The Shopping District.

south.description: To the south lies The Stone Fountain.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance To The Treasury.

20633.description:
A cobbled apron stretches before a row of shopfronts, where hand-painted
signs advertise everything from rope to ribbons. A bench of rough planks
sits against the rock, polished by the seats of gossips. A narrow
doorway to the north is marked Bits and Pieces, a lane leads east to the
shopping district, and the fountain's water can be heard south. West
stands the grim iron-bound door of the treasury.

20634.name: The Shopping District

north.description: To the north lies Drapor's Shoe Fayre.

east.description: To the east lies Cavern Entrance.

south.description: To the south lies The Middle Of The Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies In Front Of The Shops.

20634.description:
A bustling lane lined with shopfronts cut into the rock, each with a
painted wooden sign swinging over its door. Awnings of patched canvas
shade tables of tools, lamp oil and dried food, and the cobbles are
slick with spilled wash-water. A doorway marked with a painted boot
leads north into Drapor's Shoe Fayre, and the lane runs east to the
cavern entrance, south toward the middle of the town, and west past more
shops.

20635.name: Bits and Pieces

south.description: To the south lies In Front Of The Shops.

20635.description:
Every inch of this crammed shop holds something: coils of rope, odd
gloves, cracked lanterns, bent spoons and a hundred keys that fit
nothing. Narrow aisles twist between the stacks, and a counter at the
back is buried under a drift of receipts and string. Dust lies on
everything, and a smell of old metal and machine oil lingers. The only
way out is the doorway south, back to the front of the shops.

20636.name: The South Western Corner

north.description: To the north lies The Extreme Western Wall.

east.description: To the east lies The Cavern Wall.

south.description: To the south lies The Repair Shed.

west.description: To the west lies The Warehouse.

20636.description:
Where the cavern wall bends into its southwestern pocket, the rock leans
in over the lane and the lamp-light turns amber. A low shed with a tin
roof squats to the south, ringing with the sound of hammers on metal.
East the lane follows the wall, north it runs up beside the western edge
of the town, and west a wide doorway opens on a warehouse.

20637.name: The Warehouse

east.description: To the east lies The South Western Corner.

west.description: To the west lies The Rift In Space.

20637.description:
A long, cluttered warehouse of stacked crates, barrels and coils of
rope, its rafters hung with dusty lamps. Narrow paths wind between the
stacks, and everything wears a skin of grey dust. At the western end the
air seems to ripple and shimmer, like heat over a summer road. The wide
doorway east leads back to the cavern, and a strange passage waits west.

20638.name: The Rift In Space

west.description: To the west lies The Warehouse.

east.description: To the east lies The Warehouse.

20638.description:
The air hangs torn here, a long rent in the world that shimmers pale and
cold in the gloom. Beyond its edge you glimpse a warehouse far away, lit
by honest daylight and smelling of sawdust and tar. The ground trembles
gently, and loose pebbles rise a finger's breadth and fall again. To the
west the rift opens onto Garathorm, and a warehouse waits at its end,
the only way out of this lonely place.

extra_descs.rift tear rent:
The rent hangs in the air at about the height of a door, its edges
rippling like silk in a draught. Through it you can see sunlight and
wooden crates.

20639.name: The Cavern Wall

north.description: To the north lies The Stone Fountain.

east.description: To the east lies The Cavern Wall.

south.description: To the south lies An Empty House.

west.description: To the west lies The South Western Corner.

20639.description:
The town presses up against the foot of a streaked rock wall here, and
narrow lamps are bracketed into the stone at even intervals. A faded
notice is nailed to a post, its edges curled by the damp. The lane leads
north to the fountain, east along the wall, and west toward a corner,
while a battered door to the south stands slightly ajar on an empty
house.

20640.name: The Cavern Wall

north.description: To the north lies The Middle Of The Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies By The Huge Stone Gates.

south.description: To the south lies The Guard House.

west.description: To the west lies The Cavern Wall.

20640.description:
A stretch of the cavern wall stained rust-red by seeping water, with a
row of iron rings set into the rock for tethering pack mules. Hoofprints
and cart tracks cross the grit, leading east toward the huge stone
gates. North the ground rises toward the middle of the cavern, west the
wall continues, and a sturdy door to the south opens on the guard house.
A smell of horse and wet stone hangs in the air.

20641.name: By The Huge Stone Gates

north.description: To the north lies The Cavern Centre.

east.description: To the east lies The Construction Site.

south.description: To the south lies Before The Bridge To Moria Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Cavern Wall.

20641.description:
Two enormous gates of dressed stone, taller than any ten men, stand in
the cavern wall, their iron-banded leaves swung wide on hinges thick as
barrels. Beyond them a broad stone bridge runs out over a gulf toward
the deep halls of Moria. Cold air breathes through the opening and stirs
the dust at your feet. Lanes go north to the cavern centre, east to the
construction site and west along the wall, and the open gates lead south
toward the bridge.

extra_descs.gates hinges leaves:
The gates are carved with rows of marching dwarves and strange letters,
worn almost smooth. They have been left standing open for as long as
anyone here can remember.

20642.name: An Empty House

north.description: To the north lies The Cavern Wall.

20642.description:
Dust lies thick on the floor of this abandoned miner's house,
undisturbed except by the tracks of mice. The hearth is cold, the table
bare, and a single chair has toppled onto its back as though the owner
rose in sudden alarm. Faint scratches mark the inside of the door, low
down. The only way out is north, to the cavern wall.

20643.name: The Construction Site

north.description: To the north lies The Overseer's Pedestal.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Escape.

south.description: To the south lies The Hole.

west.description: To the west lies By The Huge Stone Gates.

20643.description:
Half-raised walls of fitted stone stand around a field of rubble and
sledge-marked slabs, and timber scaffolds creak against the rock. A
stack of unused blocks has been chalked with numbers by a builder who
never came back to finish. Dust hangs thick enough to taste. Lanes lead
north to the pedestal, east to the Great Escape and west to the huge
stone gates, and a rough slope drops away south into the Hole.

20644.name: The Great Escape

north.description: To the north lies Middle Of The Cavern.

east.description: To the east lies The South Eastern Corner.

south.description: To the south lies Magluff's Tavern.

west.description: To the west lies The Construction Site.

20644.description:
This wide junction of lanes takes its name from an old joke among the
miners, who call it the nearest thing to freedom in the depths. A
trodden square of packed grit is ringed by lamp poles, and a rusty bell
hangs from a post at its middle. The smell of stale beer drifts from
Magluff's Tavern to the south. Lanes run north toward the middle of the
cavern, east to a corner, and west to the construction site.

20645.name: The South Eastern Corner

north.description: To the north lies The Far Eastern Wall.

east.description: To the east lies The Overseer's Consultation Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Miner's Rest.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Escape.

20645.description:
Where the cavern curves around at its southern end, the town crowds into
a pocket of tight lanes and shuttered doorways. Cold light from a
hanging lamp falls on a brass plate by the east door, worn nearly smooth
by thumbs. A narrow stair of stone leads south down to the miners' rest,
and the way north goes back along the wall. West, the lane runs toward
the Great Escape.

20646.name: The Overseer's Consultation Room

north.description: To the north lies The Study.

east.description: To the east lies The Orangery.

west.description: To the west lies The South Eastern Corner.

20646.description:
A square, well-kept room where the overseer hears the miners'
grievances, with a heavy desk of black oak set before a hard chair. Maps
of the workings hang on the walls, pinned with coloured tacks, and a
ledger stands open on a lectern. Thick curtains of felt muffle every
sound from outside. Doors lead north to a study and east to an orangery,
while the way west returns to the lanes of the town.

20647.name: The Orangery

west.description: To the west lies The Overseer's Consultation Room.

20647.description:
Panes of glass, tinted green with age, wall in a small hothouse that
somehow keeps a few stubborn orange trees alive in the lamplight of the
depths. Their leaves are pale and their fruit small and hard, but the
scent is sweet after the dust of the tunnels. Troughs of black soil line
the walls, tended with surprising care. The only way out is the door
west, back to the consultation room.

20648.name: The Study

south.description: To the south lies The Overseer's Consultation Room.

up.description: To the up lies The Upstairs Bedroom.

20648.description:
Shelves of bound surveys and brittle rolled plans cover every wall of
this book-lined study, and a green-shaded lamp stands on a desk piled
with correspondence. The air smells of leather and candle smoke. A
narrow stair in the corner climbs up to the overseer's bedroom, and the
doorway south opens onto the consultation room. One shelf has been swept
bare, leaving a clean rectangle in the dust, as if something was taken
in haste.

20649.name: The Upstairs Bedroom

down.description: To the down lies The Study.

20649.description:
A heavy four-poster bed with moth-eaten hangings dominates this chamber
under a low ceiling of dressed stone. A wardrobe stands open and empty,
and the pillow still holds the shape of a head. Scratches mar the floor
around the bed, as if something had been dragged out from under it. The
stair leads down to the study, and a thin chill hangs in the room
despite the heavy blankets.

20651.name: Magluff's Tavern

north.description: To the north lies The Great Escape.

20651.description:
A smoky, low-beamed tavern, its floor strewn with sawdust and its walls
hung with dented tankards and old mining tools. A long bar of scarred
oak runs along one side, and barrels bristle with spigots behind it.
Lamps burn low in the haze, and a fiddle sits silent on a stool in the
corner. The only door leads north, back to the Great Escape.

20652.name: The Hole

north.description: To the north lies The Construction Site.

20652.description:
A rough pit gapes in the cavern floor, its sides a jumble of torn rock
and loose gravel that slides underfoot. Cold air stirs from below,
smelling faintly of rain and distant leaves, though the opening is far
too narrow to squeeze through. Marks of picks and wedges ring the rim
where someone began widening it and gave up. The only way back is north,
to the construction site.

20654.name: The Repair Shed

north.description: To the north lies The South Western Corner.

20654.description:
A low shed of corrugated tin and timber, open on one side to the cavern,
smelling of grease and hot iron. Broken picks, bent rails and cracked
wheels lie sorted in piles along the wall, and a forge in the corner
glows a sullen orange. An anvil stands scarred and ready. The only way
out is north, back to the corner of the cavern.

20655.name: The Treasury Master's Office

south.description: To the south lies Entrance To The Treasury.

20655.description:
A cramped office lined with ledgers bound in black cloth, where a high
desk stands under a single hooded lamp. A small iron safe is bolted to
the floor, its dial worn bright. The air is dry and smells of ink,
sealing wax and fear. The only way out is the door south, back to the
treasury entrance.

20656.name: Drapor's Shoe Fayre

south.description: To the south lies The Shopping District.

20656.description:
Boots and shoes cover every wall of this narrow shop, from heavy
hobnailed miners' boots strung by their laces to soft slippers hung from
the rafters like bats. The smell of leather, wax and tallow is strong
enough to taste. A cobbler's bench stands under the lamp, its wooden
lasts lined up like small feet. The only way out is the door south, onto
the shopping lane.

20657.name: Spaymoore's Diner

north.description: To the north lies Spaymoore's Kitchen.

south.description: To the south lies The Back Of The Cavern.

west.description: To the west lies The Dining Area.

20657.description:
Plank tables crowd a low room hollowed into the stone, each one scored
by years of knives and mugs. A long counter with a brass urn stands at
the rear, and the air is thick with grease, onion and pipe smoke. Tin
lamps swing from hooks overhead, throwing restless shadows across the
benches. Through a swinging door north lies the kitchen, an open arch
leads west to the dining area, and the cavern lane lies south.

20658.name: Spaymoore's Kitchen

south.description: To the south lies Spaymoore's Diner.

20658.description:
A cramped kitchen of blackened stone is dominated by a vast iron range,
its flue vanishing up a chimney drilled through the rock. Pots and
ladles of every size hang from hooks along the walls, and a deep sink of
grey slate drips steadily in the corner. The floor is gritty with flour
and coal dust. The only way out is the door south, back to the diner.

20659.name: The Miner's Rest

north.description: To the north lies The South Eastern Corner.

20659.description:
A long, low hall lined with bunks of plain boards, where off-shift
miners sleep in turns through the dim hours. Grey blankets lie rumpled,
and a rack along one wall is hung with boots left to dry. Someone has
strung a garland of dried flowers over the door as a small act of
defiance. The only way out is north, to the corner of the cavern.

20660.name: The Gents' Washroom

south.description: To the south lies The North-Eastern Corner.

20660.description:
A bare tiled room with a long trough of stone along one wall, fed by a
pipe that clanks whenever anyone tugs the chain. Hooks line the opposite
wall, hung with rough towels gone grey with use. A cracked mirror of
polished tin shows only a smear of lamplight. The only way out is the
arch south to the corner of the cavern.

20661.name: The Ladies' Washroom

north.description: To the north lies The Cubicle.

west.description: To the west lies The North-Eastern Corner.

20661.description:
A tidy washroom with a row of brass basins set into a long stone shelf,
each polished until it shines even in the weak light. A dish of yellow
soap sits beside them, and a sprig of dried heather hangs from a nail to
sweeten the damp air. A narrow door in the far wall leads north to a
private cubicle, and the arch west returns to the corner of the cavern.

20662.name: The Doctor's Waiting Room

east.description: To the east lies The Extreme Western Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Doctor Goldmine's Surgery.

20662.description:
Rows of hard benches face a counter where a harassed attendant once
recorded names, and the whole room smells of vinegar and lamp oil. A
shelf of chipped jars and a rolled cloth of bandages hangs by the door.
Pale faces seem to linger in the shadows between the lamps. A heavy
curtain to the west leads to the surgery, and the arch east opens back
on the lane.

20663.name: Doctor Goldmine's Surgery

east.description: To the east lies The Doctor's Waiting Room.

20663.description:
A scrubbed table of pale wood stands under a cluster of hanging lamps,
surrounded by trays of knives, saws and curved needles laid out in
order. Cabinets of tiny drawers line the walls, each labelled in a
small, crabbed script. The room smells strongly of spirits and herbs,
and a stained leather apron hangs from a peg. The only way out is east,
to the waiting room.

20664.name: The Newsroom

west.description: To the west lies The Far Eastern Wall.

20664.description:
Racks of ink-stained type and a squat iron press fill this cramped room,
and sheets of rough paper hang drying on lines strung from wall to wall.
The press stands silent now, a half-printed broadsheet still pinned in
its frame. Ink and oil mingle in a sharp smell, and a stool sits worn
smooth beside a slanted desk. The only door leads west, back out to the
cavern's rim.

20665.name: The Dining Area

east.description: To the east lies Spaymoore's Diner.

20665.description:
Long benches and a few round tables fill this wide alcove, where off-
shift miners eat shoulder to shoulder with their elbows out. Whitewash
flakes from the low ceiling, and a chalkboard on the wall lists the
day's stew and ale in smudged capitals. A lamp hangs over every table,
each trimmed to a different height, so that the light pools unevenly.
The only way back is east, to Spaymoore's Diner.

20666.name: The Cubicle

south.description: To the south lies The Ladies' Washroom.

20666.description:
A tiny stall closed by a plank door, hardly wider than a man's
shoulders, with a wooden seat over a deep pit that drops away into
darkness. Someone has scratched a verse into the wall in a neat hand,
and a tin lamp burns in a niche above. The draught from below is cool
and smells of nothing good. The door opens south onto the washroom.

20722.name: The Guard House

north.description: To the north lies The Cavern Wall.

20722.description:
A bare stone room with a plank table, a rack of spears and a bench worn
smooth by years of watchmen. A tally of days has been scratched into the
wall beside a narrow barred window, and the ashes of a small fire sit
cold in the grate. Keys hang from a ring by the door, and a heavy bar
stands ready to drop across it. The only way out is the door north, to
the cavern wall.

646400.name: miner dwarf man
646400.long_desc: A tired miner trudges past with a pick over his shoulder, coughing into his sleeve.
646400.description:
A broad, grey-faced man with soot in the lines of his hands and a lamp
strapped to his cap. He moves like one who has hauled stone all his life
and expects no thanks.

646401.name: shopkeeper townsman woman
646401.long_desc: A dusty shopkeeper straightens her wares and watches the lane with weary eyes.
646401.description:
A stout woman in a flour-streaked apron, with a ring of keys at her belt
and a cautious eye for strangers. She has plainly seen more than she
cares to say about the tunnels.

646402.name: spider tunnel pale
646402.long_desc: A pale tunnel spider clings to the rock, its legs twitching in the dark.
646402.description:
A bloated, bone-white spider as large as a dog, with eyes like tiny
black pearls. Its fangs drip a sour fluid that eats at the stone beneath
it.

646403.name: wight miner undead rubble
646403.long_desc: A rubble wight drags itself along the tunnel, stone dust spilling from its gaunt frame.
646403.description:
The withered corpse of a long-dead miner, shrouded in grey dust and
still gripping the splintered haft of a pick. Cold light flickers in the
hollows where its eyes should be.

646404.name: troll cave tunnel
646404.long_desc: A hulking tunnel troll squats in the rubble, gnawing a splintered beam.
646404.description:
A huge, hunched troll with skin the colour of wet slate and arms that
hang to its knees. Rock dust clings to its warty hide, and its small red
eyes follow you hungrily.

646405.name: foreman brakk hollow
646405.long_desc: Brakk the Hollow Foreman stalks the end of the tunnels, a ghastly lamp burning in his chest.
646405.description:
Once the foreman of the deepest dig, Brakk is now a gaunt, grey thing
with a lantern of cold fire where his heart should be. His cracked voice
still barks orders to a crew long dead.

646406.name: overseer harrok corrupted
646406.long_desc: Overseer Harrok the Corrupted looms atop his pedestal, black veins crawling beneath his skin.
646406.description:
The old overseer of Brethrenmere stands rigid as a statue, his coat
rotting and his eyes lit with the same dull silver as the deepest
tunnels. Whatever he found in the dark has made him its master and
servant at once.

746400.name: miner's helm iron cap
746400.room_desc: A dented miner's helm lies here.
746400.description: A stout iron cap with a bracket for a lamp, dented by many a fall of rock. It is heavy but wears well.

746401.name: shard darkglass black glass
746401.room_desc: A shard of black glass glints here.
746401.description: A sliver of glassy black rock with veins of silver that seem to pulse. Jewellers in the cities would pay well for it.

746402.name: gauntlets stone rubble gloves
746402.room_desc: A pair of stone-plated gauntlets lies here.
746402.description: Leather gloves studded with chips of grey stone, still dusty from the tunnels. They grip a haft as if it were part of the hand.

746403.name: pick foreman's pick iron
746403.room_desc: An iron pick with a cold gleam lies here.
746403.description: A long-hafted iron pick with a head worn narrow by years of use. A faint chill runs along the metal.

746404.name: chain overseer's chain silver
746404.room_desc: A heavy silver chain of office lies here.
746404.description: A heavy chain of linked silver, worn by the overseers of Brethrenmere. Dark threads run through the links, and it is cold against the skin.
